question: A 2021 census housing table lists a dwelling in the 1961–1980 period of construction. Can I use that to say its current occupants moved in before 1981?
generated_answer: No, you cannot. The 2021 census housing table only provides information about the period of construction of the dwelling, not the year when the current occupants moved in. The current occupants may have moved in after 1980, even if the dwelling was constructed during the 1961–1980 period. To determine the year when the current occupants moved in, you would need to use a different source of information, such as a survey or interview with the occupants themselves.
